description:
Our Concealed Carry Security Hoodie offers best-in-class discrete carry while providing unbeatable warmth and comfort. The double-sided hooded sweatshirt has “SECURITY” printed across the back and front left chest, making it ideal for security guards, campus safety, bouncers, and more. This tactical hoodie has everything you need to stay comfortable and prepared while you’re on the job.

 

Discrete & Fast:

  • The passthrough kangaroo pocket allows for quick and easy access to your IWB for appendix carry. In addition, the 8.25 inch internal vertical access point ensures that most standard EDC (Everyday Carry) essentials will passthrough comfortably.

 

Staying Cool and Dry:

  • Made of 100% polyester, these hoodies wick sweat and moisture away for optimum comfort. Featuring our rapid moisture control fabric, sweat is swiftly transferred to the top layer, allowing for a quick dry. This prevents sweat from soaking through the moisture-wicking hoodie and back into your undershirt, allowing you to move freely without your clothing sticking to you.

 

Secure Storage:

  • The pullover security hoodie also features two zippered sleeve pockets with wire passthrough ports, allowing you to safely tuck away your phone, wallet, or other essentials. The right sleeve includes a dual pen pocket for keeping writing utensils, while the left sleeve features a loop panel for adding morale and flag patches.

 

Warm & Comfortable:

  • With a soft fleece lining, these pullover hooded sweatshirts offer all-day (and all-night) comfort. The drawstring hood keeps your head and neck warm while protecting you against cold wind and rain. The built-in thumbholes preserve your hands’ heat without sacrificing your mobility and range of motion.

 

Discreetly Carry in Confidence:

  • Rothco stands out as the leader in concealed carry clothing and accessories. With a rich heritage spanning over 7 decades, we have honed our expertise in crafting durable and effective CCW gear. Our extensive range of products, including apparel, bags, and gear, showcases a diverse selection of specialized concealed carry items. From public safety and military personnel, to privately armed citizens, Rothco is the go-to brand for concealed carry apparel and gear.
